exit 0
--- stdout
Install, verify, and configure optional local tools used by Liza agents and project activation.
Usage:
liza toolchain [command]
Available Commands:
configure Write machine-local toolchain env and optional project activation
doctor Check selected toolchain tools
install Install selected local Liza toolchain CLIs
list List known Liza toolchain tools
Flags:
-h, --help help for toolchain
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
Use "liza toolchain [command] --help" for more information about a command.
--- stderr
